# Menu

**Class:** `UltraCanvasMenu` · **Group:** [Navigation and data views](../Groups/Navigation-and-data-views.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasMenu.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasMenu.h) · `#include "UltraCanvasMenu.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

Menu bar, popup and context menus

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasMenu> CreateMenu( const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasMenu> CreateMenuBar( const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasMenu> CreateMenuBar( const std::string& identifier);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasMenu(const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h);
UltraCanvasMenu(const std::string& identifier, float w, float h);
explicit UltraCanvasMenu(const std::string& identifier);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onMenuOpened` | `std::function<void()> onMenuOpened` | _Menu opened_ |
| `onMenuClosed` | `std::function<void()> onMenuClosed` | _Menu closed_ |
| `onItemSelected` | `std::function<void(int)> onItemSelected` | _Item selected_ |
| `onItemHovered` | `std::function<void(int)> onItemHovered` | _Item hovered_ |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`

### enum `MenuRadioShape`

Outline of a Radio item's indicator. The dot inside is always round; this picks the ring around it.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Round` | a circle, as UltraCanvasRadio draws it (the default) |
| `Square` | the same box a Checkbox item gets (the earlier look) |

### enum `MenuCheckboxShape`

Outline of a Checkbox item's indicator. The tick inside is the same either way, so a round checkbox still reads as "on / off" rather than as one choice of several.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Square` | a box, as UltraCanvasCheckbox draws it (the default) |
| `Round` | a circle, the outline a Round Radio item gets |

### enum `MenuIconTint`

How an entry's icon is coloured (MenuStyle::iconTint).

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Symbolic` | Icons drawn in one shade of grey - line glyphs such as the menu icons in media/icons/menu, which GTK calls "symbolic" - are painted in the entry's text colour, so they follow the theme, the hover and the disabled state as the label does: light on a dark menu, where their own black vanished. A coloured icon (an … |
| `Original` | Every icon in its own colours (the earlier behaviour). |
| `AllIcons` | Every icon painted in the text colour, coloured ones too. (Not "Always": X11's X.h defines that name as a macro.) |

### enum `MenuAnchorAlign`

Which edges of a menu opened with OpenMenuAnchored line up with the anchor's.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Left` | the menu's left edge under the anchor's left edge (the default) |
| `Right` | the menu's right edge under the anchor's right edge |

### struct `ItemWidth`

What is kept per entry between draws and layout passes, one slot per item and in step with `items` (AddItem, InsertItem, RemoveItem and Clear move the slots as they move the items): the label's layout (UltraCanvasTextLayoutCache - a menu is repainted on every hover) and the measured width with what it was measured from (a layout pass asks for every width, and the measure shapes the label each time it is taken).

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `shortcut` | `std::string label, shortcut` |  |
| `font` | `FontStyle font` |  |
| `icon` | `bool icon = false, submenu = false, check = false, vertical = false` |  |
| `iconSize` | `int iconSize = 0, iconSpacing = 0, shortcutSpacing = 0` |  |
| `width` | `int width = -1` |  |

### struct `EntryCache`

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `label` | `UltraCanvasTextLayoutCache label` |  |
| `width` | `ItemWidth width` |  |

### struct `LeadingColumns`

The columns in front of the labels of a vertical menu: one for the Checkbox / Radio indicators when any visible item has one, one for icons when any has an icon. Every label starts after both, so the labels line up down the menu whichever items carry what.

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `check` | `bool check = false` |  |
| `icon` | `bool icon = false` |  |
